crew.overview: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.
crew.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron

details.biography: Jay Hunter grew up in Barrington, IL and studied film at The University of Colorado at Boulder. It was there that Jay was exposed to both world cinema and experimental non-narrative filmmaking while studying with avant-garde luminary Stan Brakhage. This unconventional approach to cinema set the tone for his future career in the film industry which has taken many eclectic twists and turns. Jay has served as Cinematographer as well as Director on a multitude of feature films, episodic television shows and unscripted television series since moving to Los Angeles in 2001.
details.name: Jay Hunter
